description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema_Validator, which performs validation on HTMLPurifier configuration schema interchange objects. It includes methods for validating namespaces, directives, IDs, allowed values, aliases, and orchestrates error handling and context management.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema_Validator
classes.description: Performs various validation routines on configuration interchange objects related to HTMLPurifier, ensuring schema integrity and correctness.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the validator with a new HTMLPurifier_VarParser instance.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the entire interchange object, checking namespace and directive integrity.

methods.name: validateNamespace
methods.description: Validates a namespace object, checking for non-empty, alphanumeric namespace and description.

methods.name: validateId
methods.description: Validates an ID object, confirming it is of the correct class, refers to an existing namespace, and has proper format.

methods.name: validateDirective
methods.description: Validates a directive object, including its ID, description, type, default, allowed values, and aliases.

methods.name: validateDirectiveAllowed
methods.description: Validates the allowed values array of a directive, ensuring it's a lookup, non-empty, and values are strings.

methods.name: validateDirectiveValueAliases
methods.description: Validates the valueAliases array of a directive, ensuring keys and values are strings, not self-aliased, and consistent with allowed values.

methods.name: validateDirectiveAliases
methods.description: Validates the alias IDs of a directive, checking for collisions among directives and aliases.

methods.name: with
methods.description: Creates a new ValidatorAtom instance for a specific object member for validation.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Throws a validation exception with contextual information.

methods.name: getFormattedContext
methods.description: Returns a string representing the current validation context stack.
